method: Actual reading of all 47 stratified source comments; language-boundary cases were separately read. Not independent human labeling or an accuracy estimate.

reviews.notes: English: forced closure after update directly supports stability. One star agrees with negative wording; no business journey is named.
English: 'good' supports the five-star proxy but gives no business topic. Correctly retained and unclassified.
Cantonese/Traditional Chinese: repeated crashes at login support stability and authentication. One star is consistent with frustration.
Chinese: transfer completes but display synchronization is slow; performance and transfers are both relevant. Three stars remains neutral by rating despite critical text.
Chinese: '好用' praises usability. Five-star positive; the topic is a positive mention, not a complaint.
Mixed Cantonese/English: redundant login push notifications while opening stocks. Login label is relevant; no notification-specific or investment topic exists.

Mixed Cantonese/English: crashes after username/password entry, plus request for screen captures after transfers/account opening. Five topics are supported. Three-star neutral proxy masks critical text.
English: poor verification process directly matches authentication. One star agrees; source text does not identify the exact failure stage.
English: worries about visible user name and doxxing support security/privacy. Three stars is neutral by proxy; a suggested change is not captured by the limited suggestion patterns.
English: 'Fast and Great' is positive and five-star, but does not specify a journey. Unclassified is reasonable; fast is not a performance-problem assertion.
Simplified/Cantonese Chinese: objects to Samsung utility/accessibility risk blocking. Security risk terms are relevant; exact installation/access policy failure is not confirmed.
Cantonese: '唔好用' is negative usability wording. Three-star neutral rating differs from the text; the proxy is intentionally retained.
Chinese: convenience and speed praise supports usability. Five-star positive; no concrete complaint or defect is stated.
Chinese crash report includes HyperOS, Beta and device/version tokens, triggering mixed. Stability fits, but technical identifiers do not prove substantive bilingual prose.
Mixed Cantonese/English: asks for fewer logoff animations and back-button exit. Usability and explicit request fit; three stars stays neutral by rating.
English: 'not user friendly' is a usability criticism. One star is consistent; no specific journey is stated.
English: poor face recognition supports authentication. Three-star neutral rating is more favorable than the critical wording.
English: 'good' gives no concrete journey. Five-star positive and unclassified topic are appropriate for triage.
Chinese: '非常差' expresses broad dissatisfaction. One-star negative fits; no topic should be invented.
Chinese: '太卡顿了' directly reports lag. Stability fits while the source three-star rating remains neutral.
Chinese: easy interface operation is usability praise. Five-star positive, not a reported defect.
Mixed Cantonese/English: criticizes username/password login design. Authentication fits; a desired alternative is implied rather than explicitly matched as a feature request.

Mixed Chinese/English: details risk checks, crashes and fingerprint/login behavior. Stability, authentication and risk mentions fit. Feature-request is an overmatch from '不应该出现'; this is descriptive, not a requested feature.
English: small fonts and changing layout obstruct urgent card suspension amid suspected scam. Design, cards and security are supported; one-star negative agrees.
English: questionnaire exceeds viewport on iPhone and close button is hard to find. Usability fits. Three-star neutral is a rating proxy, not a statement of satisfaction.
English: title 'Easy' and body 'Easy to make' are positive but underspecified. Five-star and unclassified are retained without assuming a journey.
Cantonese/Traditional Chinese: password recovery terms screen causes app to exit. Authentication and stability fit after adding the '彈app' expression.
Traditional Chinese: asks for reduced graphics/animation and waiting at login. Performance, authentication and feature-request fit; three-star neutral retains source rating.
Traditional Chinese: easy layout and selection are usability praise. Five stars matches positive wording.
Mixed Cantonese/English: angry about scratch-card marketing and a paid membership offer. One star agrees; taxonomy has no marketing topic, so unclassified is an acknowledged coverage gap.
English: recurring unspecified error message fits stability/error screening. One star agrees, but exact error and root cause are unknown.
English: explicitly suggests consolidating financial apps to save storage. Feature request fits; the text does not report an actual payment failure.
English: Nice/Good is generic praise. Five stars aligns; no journey topic can be justified.
Cantonese with 'loading': app loads continuously then service unavailable. Stability fits. Generic online service wording is not customer support; rule avoids that false support match.
Simplified Chinese: redesign request, login/FPS popup, missing transaction details and complex navigation support all five assigned themes. Three-star neutral masks clear criticisms.
Chinese: says experience is good and friendly to mainland users. Five stars fits, but no specific app journey is identified.
Mixed title/body: step count does not update and waits a long time. One-star dissatisfaction is clear. Current performance patterns miss this phrasing, so unclassified is a known false negative.
Chinese title with English body praises the app and hopes policy does not affect service. Mixed routing is reasonable. Five stars fits; generic maintenance hope is not detected as a feature request.
English: repeated HKID scanning failure on a stated phone model supports authentication. One star fits; no device compatibility cause is confirmed.
English: title suggests improvement and body requests one-click credit-card payment. Payment/cards and feature request are supported; three-star neutral is retained.
English: title identifies first term deposit and body says easy. Deposit/payment theme is a mention, not a failure; five-star positive fits.
Traditional Chinese: identity/photo and face recognition fail after device change; old phone also cannot log in. Authentication fits; source text alone cannot establish cause.
Cantonese: title and body repeat vague dissatisfaction with unclear practices. Three-star neutral is retained; no specific journey can be responsibly assigned.
Traditional Chinese: fast transfer is positive transfer feedback. Five stars agrees; this is not a transfer complaint.
Mixed Cantonese/English: FaceID removed after upgrade, registration failure, locked account and branch visit. Authentication, support and registration all fit; one star agrees.
Mixed Cantonese/English: app hangs when sharing a saved screen through WhatsApp. Stability fits after matching Latin terms adjacent to Han; three-star neutral remains a proxy.
Chinese title with English body: easy to use and very good. Mixed routing and usability praise fit; five stars agrees.
